service.description: The pay grades the caller reads (the shared ones and those owned by an employer in scope; with organizationPartyId, an employer in scope, the ones its positions take: its own and the shared ones), by name, searched by name or id ignoring case (or the one payGradeId names), paged (an export up to 2000): each its name, owner and comments, and whether the caller may change it, for any staff reader. For a holder of PAYROLL_VIEW also the band in effect on asOfDate (else the next one: dates, currency, frequency, minimum, reference and maximum), the count of bands, whether the caller may change it, its revision and, for the grade payGradeId names, every band, newest first (bands); amountsShown says which. Without PAYROLL_VIEW no band, amount, currency or frequency is in the answer. Refuses a caller who reads no employer (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

parameter.name: payGrades
parameter.description: payGradeId, gradeName, comments, organizationPartyId, organizationName (empty for a shared grade), amountsShown, canEdit; with PAYROLL_VIEW bandCount, band (fromDate, fromDateText, thruDateText, currencyUomId, timePeriodTypeId, frequencyText, minAmount, amount, maxAmount, state, stateText) and revision

parameter.name: bands
parameter.description: Every band of the grade payGradeId names, for PAYROLL_VIEW

service.description: A new pay grade (gradeName, comments, and its owner organizationPartyId, an employer in scope, or none for a grade shared by every employer), or a grade's new name or comments at the revision read, and with the band fields a new band from fromDate (now when empty) to an optional end: the band in effect then ends on that date and the new one starts, both kept; no employment salary is changed. A band needs a currency, a pay frequency (a Payroll time period type) and a minimum, reference (amount, F4) and maximum, the minimum at most the reference and the reference at most the maximum. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an owner outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a new or changed shared grade without PEOPLE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS (PERMISSION_DENIED), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), a missing grade or another employer's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), another owner (OWNER_CHANGE), a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED), no or an unknown currency (CURRENCY_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID), no or another frequency (FREQUENCY_REQUIRED, FREQUENCY_INVALID), a missing, negative or too fine amount (AMOUNT_REQUIRED, AMOUNT_INVALID, CURRENCY_PRECISION), amounts out of order (BAND_ORDER), an end on or before the start (DATES_INVALID) and a band from that date or later already set (BAND_SCHEDULED).

The pay components of the employers the caller reads (or organizationPartyId, an employer in scope), searched by code or name ignoring case (term), of a kind, in a state on asOfDate (draft, current, future or ended; ended ones only when asked), paged (an export up to 2000): each its code, name, kind, employer, and the term in effect (else the next, else the draft): basis, calculation, unit, dates and state. With payrollComponentId, the component (its revision, the draft term's id), every term newest first (formula, declared inputs, dependencies, currency or unit, rounding stage, payslip visibility, account mapping, who published it) and the examples of the term asked for (payrollComponentTermId, else the draft, else the one in effect). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A new pay component of an employer in scope (componentCode, a name a formula may use, unique in the employer; componentName; componentKindEnumId: earning, deduction, employer contribution or statistical), or a component's new name, description or end (end, componentThruDate) at the revision read; and with any term field its draft term: created from fromDate (now when empty) when it has none, else changed (payrollComponentTermId names it). A term is a fixed amount or a formula (the framework's decimal expression over the declared inputNames and the codes of the components it reads, which become its dependencies), in its currency (required for money: no implicit currency) or a statistical value's unit, with an optional rounding stage (places and direction), payslip visibility and its account mapping (an earning's expense account, a deduction's liability account, a contribution's both, a statistical value's none). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED), another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), and CODE_REQUIRED, CODE_INVALID, CODE_TAKEN, NAME_REQUIRED, KIND_INVALID, COMPONENT_ENDED, COMPONENT_IN_USE, TERM_PUBLISHED (a published term is never changed), BASIS_REQUIRED, BASIS_INVALID, AMOUNT_REQUIRED, AMOUNT_INVALID, FORMULA_REQUIRED, FORMULA_INVALID (the evaluator's message, position and code), CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY (the formula reads the component itself), INPUT_INVALID, CURRENCY_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID, CURRENCY_PRECISION, UNIT_REQUIRED, UNIT_INVALID, ROUNDING_INVALID, STATISTICAL_NO_POSTING, ACCOUNT_NOT_FOR_KIND, ACCOUNT_INVALID (not one of the employer's) and DATES_INVALID.

A named example of a component's draft term (payrollComponentTermId, else the draft): added, changed (payrollComponentExampleId) or removed (remove), at the component's revision. inputValues gives each name the formula reads a decimal ("name = value" pairs, a JSON object or a map); expectedAmount is what the term must give. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), no draft (NO_DRAFT), a published term (TERM_PUBLISHED), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), a value that is not a name and a decimal (VALUE_INVALID) and no or a bad amount (AMOUNT_REQUIRED, AMOUNT_INVALID).

A component's term (payrollComponentTermId, else the draft, else the one in effect) computed for each of its examples beside the amount expected (actual amount, whether it matches, the explanation: the formula with the values read and its rounding, or the evaluator's refusal such as a missing input), whether all pass, and, with inputValues, the amount those values give. A statistical component is shown with no total it enters (inTotals false). Reads and computes only. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no term (NO_TERM) and unreadable values (VALUE_INVALID).

A component's draft term published from its date (or fromDate), with a reason (the audit row's), at the revision read; the published term in effect then ends on that date. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), an ended component (COMPONENT_ENDED), no draft (NO_DRAFT, TERM_PUBLISHED), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), the term's own refusals (store#Component's), a mapping its kind needs (MAPPING_REQUIRED), no example (EXAMPLES_REQUIRED), an example not giving its amount (EXAMPLE_FAILED, each named), a component it reads with no published term on that date (MISSING_DEPENDENCY), components reading each other (CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY, the cycle named), a published term starting on or after that date (TERMS_OVERLAP) and ending a published term in the past (EFFECTIVE_DATE_PAST).

The pay structures of the employers the caller reads (or organizationPartyId, an employer in scope), searched by name ignoring case, in a state (draft, current, future or ended; ended ones only when asked), paged: each its employer, currency, pay basis, state, dates and the count of its components on asOfDate. With payrollStructureId, the structure (its revision) and its lines in payslip order (component, kind, dates, state, parameter values, the term it calculates with), with the calculation order of its components on that date and the findings that block one (a dependency the structure lacks, a cycle, no term). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and another employer's structure (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A new pay structure of an employer in scope (structureName, currencyUomId: required, never assumed, payBasisEnumId), a copy of one (copyFromStructureId: a new structure of the same employer with the source's current lines as drafts and no assignments), or a structure's new name, pay basis, description or currency (a draft's only) or its end (end, thruDate, reason), at the revision read. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED), another employer's structure (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), NAME_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID, CURRENCY_LOCKED (a published structure's), BASIS_INVALID, EMPLOYER_CHANGE (a copy for another employer) and STRUCTURE_ENDED.

A component added to a structure as a draft line (payrollComponentId: one of the employer's in use; one draft line of a component at a time), a draft line's dates, payslip order (sequenceNum) or parameter values (the structure's values of the component's declared inputs, "name = value" pairs) changed, a draft line removed (remove), or a published line ended (end, thruDate, reason: its only change), at the structure's revision. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's structure or line (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), STRUCTURE_ENDED, COMPONENT_REQUIRED, COMPONENT_UNAVAILABLE, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_PUBLISHED, ORDER_INVALID, VALUE_INVALID and DATES_INVALID.

A sample gross to net of a structure on asOfDate, its draft lines and its components' draft terms included so it is seen before it is published: each component computed in dependency order from the sample inputValues, the structure's parameter values and the results it reads, rounded by its own stage, with its explanation or what blocks it (a missing input, a dependency the structure lacks, a cycle, another currency); results in payslip order beside the calculation order; totals (gross, deductions, employer contributions, the localization's employee and employer items, net, the net rounded to the currency with the difference, employer cost; a statistical value enters none); the items of the localization chosen (payrollLocalizationId, else the group's), computed by its registered service; and the findings (complete when none blocks). With payrollGroupId, the group's periods a year are the input periodsPerYear. Reads and computes only: no record is written and no money is created. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's structure or group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a group of another employer (EMPLOYER_CHANGE), an unknown localization (LOCALIZATION_INVALID) and unreadable values (VALUE_INVALID).

A structure's draft lines published, each from its own date or the publishing date (fromDate, now when empty), with a reason (the audit row's), at the revision read; the first publish starts the structure. Publishing reassigns no employee and rewrites no payslip. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's structure (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), STRUCTURE_ENDED, no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), no draft line (NO_DRAFT), a line's component with no published term on its start (COMPONENT_NOT_PUBLISHED), a money component in another currency (CURRENCY_MISMATCH), two lines of one component at once (TERMS_OVERLAP), no component on the date (LINES_REQUIRED), a dependency the structure lacks (MISSING_DEPENDENCY) and components reading each other (CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY).

The pay groups of the employers the caller reads (or organizationPartyId, an employer in scope), by name (ended ones with includeEnded), paged: each its employer, currency, frequency, first period, periods a year, pay-date policy, proration, time basis, workweek zone, localization and readiness (preview only in this build, with its reason: NO_LOCALIZATION, PREVIEW_ONLY for the demonstration, COVERAGE_MISSING or PROJECTION_PENDING; liveAllowed never true), its revision and whether the caller may change it. With payrollGroupId, its prepared periods (dates, pay date, state). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and another employer's group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A new pay group of an employer in scope, or a group's changes (or its end) at the revision read, its policy fields audited with the reason. Nothing is assumed: currencyUomId, timePeriodTypeId (a Payroll month, semi-month, bi-week or week), firstPeriodFromDate (yyyy-MM-dd), periodsPerYear (the annual divisor), payDateOffsetDays (days after a period's last day, -31 to 62), prorationEnumId and timeBasisEnumId are required; workweekTimeZone and the localization binding are optional. Once periods are prepared the currency, frequency and first period stay. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED), another employer's group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), live finalization (LIVE_NOT_AVAILABLE: no group can be live in this build), GROUP_ENDED, NAME_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID, FREQUENCY_REQUIRED, FREQUENCY_INVALID, FIRST_PERIOD_REQUIRED, DIVISOR_REQUIRED, DIVISOR_INVALID, PAY_DATE_REQUIRED, PAY_DATE_INVALID, PRORATION_REQUIRED, TIME_BASIS_REQUIRED, LOCALIZATION_INVALID, ZONE_INVALID and POLICY_LOCKED.

A pay group's next periodCount periods (1 to 24), after the last prepared one or from its first period's start: each Mantle's TimePeriod of the employer and the group's frequency (create#TimePeriod: made once, shared by the employer's groups of that frequency) with the group's pay date (the period's last day plus its offset). Idempotent: a period prepared already is answered as it is (created false). With preview, the same periods are answered and nothing is written, for a payroll reader. No period is closed. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (a preview) or without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an ended group (GROUP_ENDED) and a count outside 1 to 24 (COUNT_INVALID).
